sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
A note left by a dead and rotting man in the Abandoned Dungeon.
"Supposedly the fragrant stone is enshrined in a village in the Ashina Depths. But how to interpet 'throw oneself'? This is as far as that old Okami tome could take me. But did they truly reach the Fountainhead Palace? I'd like to know. but it seems I never will. Kotaro... forgive me..."
Found on a corpse in the Abandoned Dungeon, in a small enclosure on the left, after entering the dungeon.
